card.name: Sedation scale and injection step text
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or punctuation in the sedation alertness scale table (e.g. 'Responds only after...'), and step-number periods or pauses in injection or patch instructions.

modes.label: Sedation scale table
modes.description: Linking words inside the alertness/sedation scoring rows about responding to name or prodding.
modes.example: Responds only after name is called loudly<< and>>/or repeatedly slurring or prominent slowing marked

modes.label: Injection and patch steps
modes.description: Periods or spaces in step-by-step hand instructions such as removing a needle cover or pressing a patch.
modes.example: With syringe held upward, remove needle cover<<.>> Pinch up a large area of skin

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about hand actions and posture, like holding, gripping and standing, and away from 'overnight'.
